scope: Submission writing, long-form paper, deck, subtitles and upload materials

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: Repeated defensive qualifications interrupted the design explanation.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Organized the narrative around the engineer task, processing mechanism, observed case result and reason; placed data conditions at the relevant method or result.

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: The three creative mechanisms were described abstractly.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Distinguished requirement changes, preference changes and formulation changes through their inputs, calculations and saved records.

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: Different data scopes were easy to confuse.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Explained the 180 historical operation keys, 84-case directory, 35-record numeric subpool and 100-record modeling pool with separate purposes.

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: Case descriptions lacked enough original values and reasoning.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Added all feasible candidate values, the C2 strain tie and TSR comparison, C3 preference alternatives, C4 change preview and C5 deletion witnesses.

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: The modeling narrative did not show the exploratory results in enough detail.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Reported nested grouping, full-precision MAE comparison, input collisions, intervals and historical selection replays.

editorial_findings_and_changes.finding: Commercial writing overused statements about absent evidence.
editorial_findings_and_changes.change: Described customer hypotheses, a limited first delivery, task-based trial acceptance, workload-based pricing and a future economic accounting method.
